 * Auto-generated abstract weaver class for EdgeWeaver.
 */

    public List<String> getJoinPointClassNames() {
        return List.of(
            "joinpoint",
            "base",
            "level1",
            "level2",
            "reservedKeyword"
        );
    }

    @Override

        return "base";
    }

        return true;
    }
}
